cat > /tmp/run_all_evals.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

source /etc/network_turbo
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /root/provenance_weight_training

EXPS=(
  "detect_remove_q03_seed123"
  "detect_remove_q03_seed456"
  "epoch_matched_dr_seed123"
  "epoch_matched_dr_seed456"
  "detect_remove_q01_seed42"
  "detect_remove_q02_seed42"
)

for exp in "${EXPS[@]}"; do
  CKPT="/root/autodl-tmp/output/models/${exp}/final"
  OUT="/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/output/eval_results/${exp}_downstream/"
  echo "===== START: ${exp} at $(date) ====="
  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 python -m lm_eval \
    --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=${CKPT},dtype=float16 \
    --tasks arc_easy,arc_challenge,hellaswag,piqa,winogrande \
    --batch_size auto \
    --num_fewshot 0 \
    --output_path ${OUT}
  echo "===== DONE: ${exp} at $(date) ====="
done

echo "ALL_EVALS_COMPLETE"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /tmp/run_all_evals.sh
